# docs-ai-reverse

> OpenAI-compatible gateway that adapts Docs AI backends (Mintlify, Inkeep, Stripe, ReadMe) into Chat Completions and Responses APIs.

This file helps LLMs and AI crawlers discover the project. Prefer the linked docs over guessing behavior from file names alone.

## Project

- Name: docs-ai-reverse
- Go module: claude-code-chat
- Repository: https://github.com/6Kmfi6HP/docs-ai-reverse
- Site: https://6kmfi6hp.github.io/docs-ai-reverse/
- Language: Go 1.26+
- License: not declared (no LICENSE file yet)

## Models

- `claude-docs` → Mintlify (code.claude.com / leaves.mintlify.com)
- `anthropic-docs` → Inkeep (Anthropic docs / api.inkeep.com)
- `stripe-docs` → Stripe docs AI (ai.stripe.com)
- `readme-docs` → ReadMe Ask AI (docs.readme.com)

## API surface

- `GET /v1/models`
- `POST /v1/chat/completions`
- `POST /v1/responses`
- Auth: Bearer token from `config.yaml` → `api-keys`
